lead: Your sessions, exams and certificates in one place.

exam_in_progress.title: Continue your exam
exam_in_progress.body: You have an exam in progress for {course}. The timer is still running.

exam_available.title: Your exam is ready
exam_available.body: Your attendance for {course} is confirmed. You can take the exam now.

session_upcoming.title: Get ready for your live session
session_upcoming.body: {course} starts on {date}. Open the joining instructions and test your audio beforehand.

attendance_pending.title: Waiting for your attendance to be recorded
attendance_pending.body: The instructor records attendance for {course} after the session. Your exam opens as soon as it is confirmed.

action_required.title: Something needs your attention
action_required.body: There is an issue with {course}. Open the details to see what to do.

passed.title: Well done — all complete
passed.body: You have completed your courses. Your certificates are ready to download.

empty.title: You are not enrolled in a course yet
empty.body: Choose a live session to get started. Your joining instructions, exam and certificate will appear here.

detail.joinLead: These details are private to you. Please do not share the link.
detail.joinPending: The meeting link has not been added yet. It will appear here before the session starts.

step.attendanceNeed: At least {percent}% attendance, recorded by the instructor.
step.examNeed: Pass mark {pass}%. Up to {max, plural, one {1 attempt} other {# attempts}}.
step.examLocked: Opens after your attendance is confirmed.
step.certificateNeed: Issued automatically when both steps above are complete.

certificates.title: My certificates
certificates.lead: Download your certificates or share the verification link.

empty.title: No certificates yet
empty.body: A certificate appears here when you have attended the session and passed the exam.
